description: Machine-readable readiness matrix for arbitrary-repo repair. Rows: Python/pip/pytest, Rust/cargo, Go/go test, TypeScript/npm/jest, TypeScript/npm/vitest, Java/Maven/JUnit, Java/Gradle/JUnit, Unknown. Columns: adapter_backed, verifier_backed, model_route_exists, mocked_repair_trace_exists, safe_patch_workspace_supported, human_approval_gate_exists, ide_state_exposed, corpus_guard_exists, live_model_admitted. Each row carries a closed-set ready_level. Pure function: no execution, no subprocess, no network.
purpose: Rung 9 of the verified-repair campaign. Surfaces a precise, machine-readable picture of where the apparatus is — and is not — ready. The IDE / CLI / audit tools consume this directly. Unsupported rows are explicitly BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED; no row is marked ready that isn't.
invariants: build_readiness_matrix is a pure function — no I/O beyond reading lock-manifest file *presence*.
Every required (language, build_system) row is present in the output.
Unsupported row (language='Unknown') carries ready_level=BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED and adapter_backed=False.
Every supported row carries a ready_level from {READY_MOCKED_TRACE, READY_TEMP_PATCH_ONLY, READY_REQUIRES_LIVE_MODEL_ADMISSION, READY_REQUIRES_VERIFIER}.
live_model_admitted is False on every row at this rung — no row falsely claims live admission.
Matrix construction is deterministic (excluding the generated_at timestamp).
scripts/intake/arbitrary_repo_readiness_*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
build_readiness_matrix calls no subprocess (defensive monkeypatch sentinel verifies this).
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
remaining_gaps: live_model_admitted is False everywhere by construction at this rung. A future LIVE rung will produce a regenerated matrix with selected rows flipped.
Capability tags per row (e.g. which model classes can serve which adapters) are not modeled — that's an IDE-rendering concern handled downstream.
Generated_at uses utc-now; the matrix is otherwise deterministic — tests assert this.
